text:
emily.recruiter: Quick heads-up 1 candidate flagged for comp-band exception. Hiring manager proposing IC4 offer instead of IC3. Proposed cash: base $160k, bonus 8%, sign-on $7k.

devin.hm: Candidate would be a direct lead on latency infra for search gateway. 6+ years infra, previously led similar migrations. We risk losing them if we stay at IC3. Candidate can start 2026-05-10 if we move quickly.

priya.hr: Tagging comp-requests. Need written manager rationale + confirmation of budget. Also note per policy director approval required for any band move. @tom.dir please weigh in.

carla.finance: We have limited headcount but can reallocate from an unfilled role this quarter. Finance ack but we still need director sign-off and a 6-month performance checkpoint if we approve above band.

tom.dir: Ok to escalate to committee if manager provides measurable goals and commits to a 6-month calibration. I can pre-approve escalation but final committee sign-off required.

comp-committee-bot: Request logged. Routing: manager -> director -> finance -> comp-committee. Ticket ID: CCQ-2026-1975. Standard SLA 48h. Urgent flag set by manager.

emily.recruiter: Candidate expects an answer within 48h. Two options suggested: 1) fast-track committee review for IC4, or 2) extend an IC3 top-of-band offer + a one-time bridging payment to hold candidate and lock start date. Which should we do?

devin.hm: Prefer full IC4. If committee can't commit quick enough, fallback to IC3 + one-time bridging payment of $10k (gross) payable after 30 days of employment. Also willing to include a 6-month review commitment in writing.

priya.hr: Drafting provisional offer language. Draft clause: 

"Offer is provisional and contingent on final Compensation Committee approval. If the committee denies the band exception, the company will provide a one-time bridging payment of $10,000 to align cash in the interim. Final compensation will be confirmed in writing following committee decision and is subject to standard employment terms."

carla.finance: Fine from finance to proceed with provisional offer, as long as the bridging payment is documented and payable only after successful start and 30 days employment. Please include clawback clause if they don't join.

emily.recruiter: I'll share a provisional offer today with a target start of 2026-05-10 and note the committee escalation. Will ask candidate to sign to secure start while we await committee.

tom.dir: I'll flag the committee chair to request expedited review. If they approve, we'll move candidate to IC4 and update payroll. If not, the bridging payment path is approved.

emily.recruiter: Thanks team 1 :thumbsup: Will update thread when candidate responds.
